draft.subject: One quick step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Following up on my note last week — you've got your first project set up in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The usual next step is getting a teammate in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through how your team at Clearwater Works is structuring work and where it best fits.

Best,
Chidi
